title: Multi-viral target Direct Detection and Nanopore Sequencing (DDNS)
author: Alison Tedcastle
materials: DreamTaq Hot Start PCR Master Mix

steps.title: Decontaminate Work Area
steps.instruction: Wipe down lab bench surfaces and pipettes with 70% ethanol and an RNAse cleaning agent (e.g., RNAse Zap).

steps.title: Prepare First Round RT-PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare separate individual master mix preparations for each target using Superscript III One-Step RT-PCR System with Platinum Taq High Fidelity.

substeps.instruction: Calculate volumes based on the number of samples, positive and negative controls, plus 10% for pipetting loss.
Reduce nuclease free water volume if larger volumes of RNA need to be processed.
Vortex the master mix briefly and spin down to gather contents at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Aliquot and Add RNA Templates
steps.instruction: Distribute the master mix and add RNA templates in a dedicated template addition room.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot the required volume of master mix into pre-labelled PCR tubes/strips.
Close lids and transfer the rack to the template addition room.
Add 5 µL of positive control or sample RNA to appropriate tubes.
Add 5 µL of nuclease free water for the negative control.
Ensure each sample is tested in duplicate, using PPMoV as an internal control.

steps.title: Perform First Round PCR
steps.instruction: Place PCR sample tubes in the Thermocycler and run the conditions relevant to the target.

steps.title: Store or Proceed with PCR Products
steps.instruction: PCR products can be stored at -20°C indefinitely, though continuing the protocol as soon as possible is advised.

steps.title: Decontaminate Work Area for DNA
steps.instruction: Wipe down lab bench surfaces and pipettes with 70% ethanol and a DNAse cleaning agent (e.g., DNAse Zap).

steps.title: Prepare Second Round PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a separate master mix for each target using DreamTaq Hot Start PCR Master Mix.

substeps.instruction: Calculate volumes for samples, positive/negative controls, plus 10% for pipetting loss.
Vortex the master mix briefly and spin down.
Aliquot 23 µL of the master mix into each PCR tube/strip.

steps.title: Aliquot and Add First Round PCR Products
steps.instruction: Add the first round PCR products to the second round mix in the template addition room.

substeps.instruction: Close lids and transfer the rack to the template addition room.
Add 2 µL of the first round PCR product to the appropriate reaction tubes.
Add 2 µL of nuclease free water for the negative control.

steps.title: Perform Second Round PCR
steps.instruction: Place PCR sample tubes in the Thermocycler and run the specified cycling conditions.

steps.title: Verify Amplification via Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Check all samples, including positive and negative controls, on a 1% agarose gel.

substeps.instruction: Verify expected band sizes (refer to Appendix 1).
Identify confirmed positive reactions for subsequent purification and quantification.

steps.title: Pool Amplicons
steps.instruction: Pool the amplicons based on the electrophoresis results.

substeps.instruction: Pool 10 µL from each duplicate amplicon, or 20 µL from the only positive reaction for each virus sample.

steps.title: Purify DNA using AMPure Beads
steps.instruction: Purify the pooled PCR samples using AMPure beads.

substeps.instruction: Allow AMPure beads to warm to room temperature.
Add an equal volume of beads to the pooled samples (e.g., 20 µL beads for a 20 µL sample) and pipette gently to mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Spin down and place on a magnetic rack until the liquid is clear and colorless, then pipette off the supernatant.
Wash the beads while on the magnet with 100 µL of 80% Ethanol, then remove and discard the ethanol.
Repeat the 80% Ethanol wash step.
Spin down and place back on the magnet to remove residual Ethanol; air dry for approximately 30 seconds.
Remove tubes from the magnet and resuspend the pellet in 20 µL nuclease free water; incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Pellet the beads on the magnet and transfer 20 µL (or as much as possible) of each sample into a clean tube.

steps.title: Quantify Purified DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the purified DNA using a Qubit Broad Range dsDNA kit.

substeps.instruction: Create a master mix of 200 µL (199 µL buffer, 1 µL Qubit reagent) for each sample, 2 standards, and 10% extra.
For standards: add 190 µL master mix to 10 µL of standard.
For samples: add 198 µL master mix to 2 µL sample.
Vortex each sample/standard and incubate for 2 minutes.
Quantify using the Qubit, ensuring the 'broad range kit' is selected.
Record the DNA concentration for each sample.

steps.title: Normalize DNA for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Normalize the DNA concentration to 200 fmol per sample.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 200 fmol of DNA per sample into a clean 96-well plate.
Adjust the final volume to 12.5 µL using nuclease free water.
Mix gently by pipetting.

steps.title: Proceed to Barcoding
steps.instruction: Continue to step 5 of the native barcoding protocol for direct detection nanopore sequencing (https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.e6nvwjko9lmk/v1).
